build_soft_teacher_detector: build a SoftTeacher detector for semi-supervised object detection with teacher and student models
get_pseudo_instances: get pseudo instances from the teacher model for unlabeled data in semi-supervised training
loss_by_pseudo_instances: calculate classification and regression losses from pseudo labeled instances for student model training
compute_uncertainty_with_aug: compute regression uncertainty by jittering bboxes and measuring prediction variance across augmented samples
aug_box: augment bounding boxes with random jitter offsets scaled by box dimensions for uncertainty estimation
